integrity.proof: self-contained finite-dimensional duality and double-counting argument

scientific_limitations: Extension-field-linear finite-field codes; ordinary Euclidean duality only.
The inverse enumerator transform is finite and exact but no polynomial-time evaluation claim is made.
A 2018 shortening-dimension identity and the Gaussian binomial theorem are key prerequisites; an older unstated equivalent transform remains a bibliographic risk.
